findings.title: Incorrect banner message for exactly $50.00
findings.detail: The `shipping_banner` function incorrectly displays 'Add $0.00 more for free shipping' when the subtotal is exactly $50.00, instead of 'Your order ships free!'. This is due to the condition `if remaining < 0` not covering the case where `remaining == 0`. [upgraded to blocking: probe confirmed by execution; reviewer said major]
findings.evidence: In `shipping_banner`, when `subtotal == 50.0`, `remaining` is `0.0`, which does not satisfy `remaining < 0`, so the function returns 'Add $0.00 more for free shipping' instead of the correct message.
findings.suggestion: Update the condition in `shipping_banner` to `if remaining <= 0` to handle the case where `remaining == 0`.
